newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli shekel little changed against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Israeli shekel little changed against dollar.

text.p: The Israeli shekel closed almost unchanged against the dollar and the basket of key foreign currencies on Thursday in thin trading, dealers said.
"Activity was slow and quiet today and the shekel was moving in tight range, said Guy Levi of Bank Leumi.
"Investors are staying on the sidelines waiting to see where the market is going," he added.

The representative rate for the dollar was fixed at 3.2780 shekels against 3.2770 shekels on Wednesday. The basket composed of the dollar, mark, pound sterling, French franc and yen, was fixed at 3.6594 shekels against 3.6612 on Wednesday.
On the crosses the shekel traded against the yen at 2.8762 shekels per 100 yen against 2.8839 on Wednesday and against the mark at 2.1081 shekels against 2.1107 on Wednesday.
In late afternoon the dollar continued to trade at 3.2780 shekels.
